title: Weapons, ammunition and knives: online sale and promotion
summary: Almost every country restricts firearms; this lists the clearest. Online sale across borders is nearly everywhere unlawful without licence. US is lawful but regulated federally and by state (some states ban categories). Most entries rely on general knowledge.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.note: Firearms need certificate/RFD; knives: Offensive Weapons Act 2019 requires age verification on sale and delivery; further tightening via Crime and Policing Bill (status unverified).

countries.name: Japan
countries.note: Firearms and Swords Control Law bans possession of firearms and most blades; online sale of firearms effectively prohibited. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.note: Arms and Explosives Act; civilian firearm sale prohibited, knife sales controlled. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: China
countries.note: Law on Control of Guns bans private firearms; controlled knives regulated. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: National Firearms Agreement; online firearm sale needs licensed dealer and permit; online knives restricted in states. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Canada
countries.note: Firearms Act: PAL and licensed business needed; mail-order sale restricted. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Germany
countries.note: Waffengesetz: licence required; online dealers need permit and transfer via licensed dealer. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: France
countries.note: Code de la securite interieure; firearm sales regulated by category. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: India
countries.note: Arms Act 1959: licence required; online sale not permitted. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: Civilian arms sales are heavily restricted; promotion unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: Federal Law 11/1976 on firearms; online sale unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Lawful: FFL required, interstate sales ship to FFL; state bans on some items; platform policies. from general knowledge, unverified.
